declared: 2026-11-28, before any run of benchmarks/v2_generalization.py. Question: do the v2 options (chosen on unicycle Bugtrap/Wall development seeds) also help on unicycle problems that were never used to choose anything, or did they only fit the two paper maps?

problems.maps_source: DynoBench (MIT); third_party/dynobench_subset/README.md. Not in the FLASK paper, so there is no paper number to compare with.
problems.random_scenes: seeds 9101-9200, verification/v5_random_low_dof.scene(): 6 m world, 3-8 random boxes 0.3-1.5 m, random start/goal positions and headings; the scene seed is also the planner seed
problems.charts: every problem is run on BOTH flat charts (forward kappa = 0 and backward kappa = 1, Eq. 10) and reported per chart: the comparison v1 vs v2 always holds the chart fixed

settings.v1: config/low_dof_v1_literal_v2b.json, unicycle family settings (the unicycle_bugtrap override; Bugtrap and Wall overrides differ only in the chart)
settings.v2: config/low_dof_v2b_order2.json, same family settings + per-planner algorithm_settings (frozen 2026-11-28, results/diagnostics/v2_factorial/selection.json)
settings.nothing_tuned: no setting is changed for these problems; v2 settings are never changed after seeing these results (any later change would need a new unseen set)

timing: parallel workers, each pinned to one even P-core (0, 2, ..., 14; siblings left idle); v1 and v2 of the same (problem, chart, planner, seed) run back to back on the same core, so the v1/v2 time ratio is paired. These times are for the v1/v2 comparison only, not for comparison with the paper.

metrics.solved: returned a path within the budget
metrics.valid: returned path passes planning.validate on the ORIGINAL model and obstacles (dense |v| <= 1, |omega| <= 1.5, collision, start/goal); every attempt is in the denominator
metrics.censored_time: plan + post-processing time, an unsolved attempt counts as the budget (10 s); per cell the median over attempts
metrics.length: mean over attempts solved by BOTH v1 and v2 (paired), reported only

cells: maps: (map, chart, planner) = 3 x 2 x 4 = 24 cells of 30 seeds; random: (chart, planner) = 2 x 4 = 8 cells of 100 scenes

criteria.G1_safety: every path returned by v2 is valid on the original model (0 invalid returns) and no attempt crashes. Same check reported for v1.
criteria.G2_no_loss_in_solving: in every cell, v2 solved count >= v1 solved count - 2 (maps, of 30) or - 5 (random, of 100)
criteria.G3_speed: v2 median censored time < v1 median censored time in at least 80 % of the cells that at least one of v1/v2 solved at least once
criteria.verdict: GENERALIZES if G1, G2 and G3 hold; otherwise PARTIAL (list failing cells) or DOES_NOT_GENERALIZE (G1 fails, or G2/G3 fail in more than half of the cells). Reported in the README whatever the outcome.
